scene: The giant golden cat leaps atop the transit concourse roof, purring loudly.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of an open transit concourse roof. On the far left sits a docked solar-sail junk. Left sits the giant golden cat, ridden by the Pacific Islander man with top knot and ukulele. Centre waits a maglev dragon train with open doors. Far right hangs an empty spherical cloud cable pod.

a maglev dragon train waiting with open doors on the track at the centre
